name: Daniel Loc Nguyen
occupation: State Representative; founder and owner of Bambuza Hospitality Group

bio.statement: The Oregon Legislature biography says Nguyen founded and owns Bambuza Hospitality Group, a restaurant business, and chairs the House economic development committee.
bio.excerpt: founded and owns Bambuza Hospitality Group, operating restaurants for 20 years alongside his wife Katherine.

collection_notes: Ballot spelling per inventory is 'Daniel Loc Nguyen'; Capital Chronicle uses 'Daniel Nguyễn'; official page 'Daniel Nguyen'. Fetched danielfororegon.com (news, priorities, about) but did not cite it because step 3 requires the domain to be linked from the pamphlet, ORESTAR, an official page or a T3 article; the pamphlet statement may confirm it, so a later pass can add its positions (it states support for a public option, AI guardrails, reproductive rights, climate goals). The legislature page links only social media. Capital Chronicle HD38 guide covers the Democratic primary (opponent Wasielewski, who is not on the November ballot). Matches inventory (unopposed in November). Pamphlet statement: SOS Clackamas edition p. 49 (same text in other editions).
